data.name: Drunk Dad vs Family
data.detailed_description:
Drunk Dad vs Family

One house. One drunk dad. Four desperate family members. Tonight, someone is finally going to bed...

Drunk Dad vs Family is a 4v1 asymmetrical co-op horror party game where hilarious family chaos meets intense multiplayer action. Team up as the Family or unleash absolute madness as the unpredictable Dad in a house where every room becomes a battlefield of traps, mind games, and laugh-out-loud moments.

🍺 Become the Dad

You're louder, stronger, and completely unpredictable.

Drink bizarre beverages to unlock powerful abilities, defend your precious refrigerators, lay devious traps, and terrorize the household with pure chaos. Break the Family's spirit before they can put an end to your rampage.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Become the Family

You're outnumbered by one... but not outsmarted.

Work together, complete mini-games, gather ingredients, and brew strange mixtures that can finally put Dad to sleep. Rescue refrigerators, avoid deadly traps, and rely on teamwork to survive the most dysfunctional family night ever.

Features

  • 🎭 4v1 Asymmetrical Multiplayer – Play as the unstoppable Dad or cooperate as four Family members.

  • 🍺 Drink to Grow Stronger – Every drink changes the game with unpredictable powers and hilarious effects.

  • 🧊 Fight Over the Fridge – Carry, steal, defend, and protect refrigerators as both teams battle for control.

  • 🧪 Brew Crazy Mixtures – Collect ingredients and create special concoctions to gain the upper hand.

  • 🎮 Traps & Mini-Games – Outsmart your opponents with clever traps and skill-based challenges.

  • 🤪 Non-Violent Chaos – No gore, just physics-driven mayhem, panic, and unforgettable party moments.

  • 🔄 Every Match Is Different – Random events, unpredictable strategies, and endless replayability.

Who Wins?

The Family Wins
Put Dad to sleep before everyone's morale collapses.

Dad Wins
Reduce the Family's morale to zero and prove who's really in charge of the house.

Every family has a breaking point.

Every Dad has one more drink.

Which side will survive the night?
